scope: All 959 tracked baseline files plus complete npm lock graph, restored WASM NuGet graph, generated Modern assets and external Jovian inputs; audit outputs intentionally excluded to avoid recursive inventory.

semantics.distributed: Tracked source is publicly accessible; object-code/public-deployment facts stated separately.
semantics.unknown: Unknown is deliberate; a path added in this fork does not establish copyright ownership.
semantics.included_in_browser: Per-file source-map inclusion, copied static asset, or compiled component; trimmed third-party types cannot be inferred individually.
semantics.modified: Upstream current-tree differences do not by themselves assign differences to TD-OHD.
